column1: # Provisional game profile of Monster Sanctuary (Switch, update v524288 over the base game), Unity 2018.4.23f1 IL2CPP with FMOD, SDK 9.4.1, NVN.
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Written from a survey of the game files (scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py with dm/games/profile_guess.py); packed on a PC, not run on a device. The keys below are
# the survey's guesses, not measured. README.md beside this file.
# 2.1.0: the update's control data (control.nacp +0x3060); the base game says 1.0.0
# every module main imports from; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie
# guess, not measured: the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap
# check that sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for was not run. FINAL FANTASY CRYSTAL CHRONICLES Remastered Edition (Unity 2018.4.2f1) and
# Raging Loop (Unity 2018.3.10f1) boot and play with these same values.
# No mem_used: for a game with a system resource the NSP script leaves it to the heap check (refine_after_rewrite), which boots the game on a Mac. The
# rewritten modules are 106 MB, more than the default 64 MB: if the first run logs "[mem] SetHeapSize ... + modules ... > app pool" and no heap after it,
# the key is mem_used 0x6e00000 (profile_guess.mem_used on the pack)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
